notes:
What's new in 0.1.71:
• Faster Movies and TV Shows: big libraries no longer freeze, and scrolling stays smooth (measured on a fast test PC).
• A cleaner Plex-style look (Beta): proper poster rows on Home, a shorter top bar, and a simpler movie page with one big Play button.
• Story Studio (In development, owner only): Appa's painted look, more scenes and props, and characters that hold props.
• Smaller fixes: clearer error messages, a nicer update dialog, and correct plurals in all languages.
